verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a hosted search/LLM API vendor could open-source its service, but no evidence shows the Sonar API's own source is published under an open license. The open-source local MCP server and the public perplexity-py SDK repo are adjacent client-side components, not the product itself. The 'open-weight models' item refers to third-party models Perplexity hosts, not Perplexity's own source.
